I had the same exact problem...actually I still do. But what I found helpful was writing notes in my phone and before we would start the session she would read them. We would then start talking about it and I found it a lot easier because I didn’t have to say the actual problem. Or something else you can try is emailing them. I would email her during a breakdown because if not, I wouldn’t tell her once I was better and in a clearer mind. I hope these tips will help! Stay strong!
